units.source_text: 那乳母看见明石姬为人亲切可爱，就做了她的话伴，忘却了一切尘劳，在宅内欢笑度日。

en.t: Seeing that Lady Akashi was warm and lovable, the nurse became her companion in conversation, forgot all worldly cares, and spent her days laughing happily within the household.

units.source_text: 前此明石道人也曾托人物色了几个身份不低于这乳母的女人来使唤。

en.t: Before this, the Akashi Novice had also asked others to find several women of rank no lower than this nurse to serve in the household.

units.source_text: 然而她们都是年事衰老的旧宫人，或者意欲入山为尼而偶尔来此者。

en.t: But they were all elderly former court ladies, or women who had happened to come there while intending to enter the mountains and become nuns.

units.source_text: 这京中来的乳母比较起她们来，人品优越得多了。

en.t: Compared with them, this nurse from the capital was far superior in character and refinement.

units.source_text: 她把世间珍奇的传说轶话讲给她们听，

en.t: She told them rare tales and curious anecdotes from the world outside,

units.source_text: 又从女子的见解，描摹源氏内大臣人品之优越，以及世人对他崇敬之真诚。

en.t: and, from a woman's point of view, described the excellence of Genji the Inner Minister's character and the sincerity of the reverence people felt for him.

units.source_text: 明石姬听了，便觉她能替他产下这个名贵的种子，自身也很可骄傲。

en.t: When Lady Akashi heard this, she felt that having borne him this precious child was something she herself could be proud of.

units.source_text: 与明石姬一同看了源氏公子的来信，乳母心中想道：“天呵！

en.t: After reading Lord Genji's letter together with Lady Akashi, the nurse thought to herself, "Heavens!

units.source_text: 她倒交了这意想不到的好运道，吃苦的只是我这一身！”

en.t: She has met with this unexpected good fortune, while I am the only one who has had to suffer!"

units.source_text: 后来看见信中写着“乳母近况如何”等殷勤挂念的话，自己也觉得万分欣慰。

en.t: Later, when she saw that the letter included such thoughtful words of concern as "How is the nurse doing these days?" she too felt deeply comforted.
